comment: Reachability gaps the Spring AOT pass cannot see, for the `smith` native binary. Embabel binds @ConfigurationProperties Kotlin data classes through kotlin-reflect (invisible to static analysis) and loads model catalogs and prompt templates as classpath resources by name. Add an entry here when the image reports a MissingReflectionRegistrationError or a resource that resolves on the JVM but not in the binary. Two entries are here for gaps the tracing agent cannot rediscover either. ToolGroupMetadata$Companion: ValidationToolGroup locates its factory by signature over getMethods(), and the factory's JVM name contains a hyphen, so no source line names it -- without this the scan comes back empty and validateToolGroup fails at context startup with 'No 5-arg ToolGroupMetadata factory found'. BuildCommand$FlowConverter: picocli instantiates an option's converter reflectively, and the traced hints carry TargetConverter and TechniqueConverter only because the runs that generated them passed --target and --technique and never --flow.
